verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements layer built on Stripe, so payout reconciliation is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, never mentions payouts, payout schedules, or breaking a payout down into charges, fees, and refunds. The documented schedule feature (createSchedule) governs subscription phases, not payout timing, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
